text: {Name} wrote poetry for years before the war. While serving as an officer near {Place}, they prepared notices for the families of soldiers killed under their command.
self_review: The officer wrote poetry before the war and later prepared notices for families of soldiers killed under their command.
source_pattern: Plausible invention; the supplied research does not document this officer's poetry or casualty-notice work.
fictional_changes: The literary interest, command responsibility, casualties, and notices are fictional.
